sources.title: Crowning Strike
markers: | description = Unleash the wails of the dead that fell to your blade, and possibly instil {{SmCond|Crown of Madness}} in the target.

sources.title: Crown of Madness (condition)
markers: *Instilled with magical madness. Will attack the nearest creature, other than the spellcaster.

summary: A +1 longsword that grants Crowning Strike.

fields.Crowning Strike: Action once per Short Rest. Attack a non-Undead Humanoid in melee for normal weapon damage. Intelligence save against weapon action DC +2 or Crown of Madness for 3 turns.
fields.Base value: 250 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Crown of Madness: The affected target attacks the nearest creature other than the caster.
